answer_1.quote: We develop a deep, end-to-end model that learns to identify mismatched query-item pairs and is also capable of generating mismatched queries given an item.
datasets: 3M matched query-item pairs from search logs
answer_1.outputs: Generated queries that are mismatched to an item but lexically similar to the original query
